_: Inkling-2-Mini (thinkingmachines/Inkling-2-Mini, 26B: 24 layers, layers 6..17 run three times) on saguaro-ik2 (src/ik2, docs/INKLING2-MINI.md; the engine: docs/INKLING2.md): unsloth's UD-Q4_K_XL GGUF at the repo's top - Unsloth's looped layout (general.architecture inkling2: inkling2.num_loops, inkling2.loop.core_start), which saguaro-ik2 reads; the files in Mainline_Support/ (inkling2_loop, llama.cpp master's) are not offered. Experts of layers 0-19 NVFP4 (their original bits), layers 20-23 and the dense weights Q8_0. The drafter: "drafter" below (thinkingmachines' own; drafting auto where it runs - NVIDIA sm_80+ holding every expert, AMD; off on Volta / Turing, the offload path and two GPUs). The file pinned by revision, size and sha256: the setup checks them.
name: Inkling-2-Mini-UD-Q4_K_XL
about: UD-Q4_K_XL: NVFP4 experts in layers 0-19, Q8_0 elsewhere; 26B parameters, 8 of 128 experts a token

vision._: The pictures: unsloth's mmproj of the model's vision tower (llama.cpp's inkling2v projector, BF16), from the same repo and revision, read by the image encoder vision-glm (tools/vision/inkling2v_patch.py) when a picture arrives; not with --no-vision.

drafter._: Drafting: thinkingmachines' own drafter of Inkling-2-Mini (mtp.safetensors, a DSpark-style draft model, BF16; Apache 2.0) from the model's repo at a pinned revision, read by saguaro-ik2 --draft; not with --drafting off. With --drafting auto the engine measures once on the PC whether it (or the prompt lookup) makes answers faster, and drafting never changes the answers.

strata._: Strata's .strata packs of Inkling-2-Mini (strata-engine/Inkling-2-Mini-Strata, Apache 2.0), read by saguaro-ik2 as they are (src/strata_fmt: every weight exactly as Strata's own decode gives it). Each pack folder holds the pack, the repo's tokenizer.json (the GGUFs' tokenizer, table for table) and config.json; pictures and drafting take UD-Q4_K_XL's mmproj and thinkingmachines' drafter as above. experts_gib: the experts as the engine holds them (a layer mixing codecs takes its widest expert's slot for each); kl: measured here against SQ-20 (the original weights), 2000 tokens of text (tools/ik2/kl.py, RX 9070 XT); kl_published: Strata's own (their test prompts).
